title: Missing IBM Cloud Activity Tracker Route in Active Production Region
description: An active production region containing compute or storage assets lacks an active IBM Cloud Activity Tracker Event Route, causing control-plane and management API audit events to be lost.
rationale: Cloud audit trails are the primary source of truth for post-incident breach investigations. Attackers actively exploit regions without logging to execute covert modifications undetected.

remediation.summary: Provision an Activity Tracker Event Route in all active regions to capture and forward audit logs.
remediation.console_steps:
1. Navigate to Observability > Activity Tracker in IBM Cloud Console.
2. Click 'Routing' > 'Create route'.
3. Select your production region and link to your audit logging target.

title: Activity Tracker Audit Logs Not Archived to Cloud Object Storage
description: Activity Tracker event stream is not targeted to an IBM Cloud Object Storage bucket for immutable long-term archive retention.
rationale: Regulatory compliance standards (ISO 27017, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) mandate minimum 1-year to 7-year audit log preservation with WORM (Write Once, Read Many) retention locks.

remediation.summary: Create an immutable COS target for Activity Tracker and enable retention lock.
remediation.ibmcloud_cli: ibmcloud atracker target create --name cos-audit-target --type cloud_object_storage --bucket-name <COS_LOG_BUCKET> --endpoint <COS_ENDPOINT>
remediation.console_steps:
1. Open Activity Tracker > Targets.
2. Add target of type 'Cloud Object Storage'.
3. Bind target to your dedicated audit logs COS bucket.

title: Critical Cloud Security Event Alerts Not Configured
description: Automated security alerts are not configured for critical administrative modifications, such as IAM policy deletion, security group rule changes, or bucket public access toggling.
rationale: Without real-time alerting, security operations centers cannot intervene in time to stop active cloud ransomware or credential abuse campaigns.

remediation.summary: Configure IBM Cloud Event Notifications integration to alert on IAM and network configuration tampering.
remediation.console_steps:
1. In IBM Cloud Console, open Event Notifications.
2. Connect Activity Tracker stream as an event source.
3. Create notification rules for IAM and VPC security events.
